page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 24 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz, with 1 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates solid mid-tier performance. Its Intel Xeon processor achieves a multi-core stress-ng score of 23,250.96 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11,384.0. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1,263.88 GB/sec and a large block uncached write speed of 62.93 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, it shows strong text generation capabilities on small language models, reaching 283.7 tokens/sec, alongside a Passmark database operations score of 11,538.47.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.r7.6xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound applications that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance, making it well-suited for in-memory databases like Redis, enterprise applications, caching layers, and moderate data processing workloads.
